section.86: Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)

86.name_native: Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)

hadiths.text: Narrated Abu Burda Al-Ansari:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Do not flog anyone more than ten stripes except if he is involved in a crime necessitating Allah's legal Punishment
